text: Arrest them! Every last one of them! Anyone preaching the name of Jesus must be brought before the authorities!
But we've done nothing wrong! We only follow the teachings of Jesus!
That man was a false Messiah! And I will not rest until his followers are silenced!
Saul, where are you going?
To Damascus. I've received permission to arrest anyone who follows this Jesus. Men or women, it makes no difference. I'll bring them back to Jerusalem in chains!
Then may God be with you on your journey.
Wait! What is that light? It's brighter than the sun! I can't see!
Saul! Saul! Why are you persecuting me?
Who are you, Lord?
I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.
Jesus? But... you're dead!
Rise and enter the city. There you will be told what you must do.
I can't see! My eyes! Everything is dark!
Saul! What's happened to you?
I heard a voice... It was Jesus! He spoke to me! Please, help me. I cannot see!
Come, we'll lead you into Damascus.
Three days have passed, and I still cannot see. I haven't eaten or drunk anything. Lord, what have I done?
Ananias!
Yes, Lord?
Go to the house of Judas on Straight Street. Ask for a man named Saul of Tarsus. He is praying.
Lord, I've heard about this man! He's imprisoned your followers and brought terrible suffering upon your people!
Go, for he is my chosen instrument to carry my name before the nations, kings, and the people of Israel.
Then I will obey you, Lord.
Saul? Are you here?
Who's there?
My name is Ananias. The Lord Jesus, who appeared to you on the road, has sent me so that you may see again and be filled with the Holy Spirit.
Jesus sent you? Even after everything I've done?
Yes, brother Saul. Receive your sight.
I... I can see! The darkness is gone! God has opened my eyes!
Then rise, Saul, and be baptized.
I spent my life believing I was serving God, yet I was fighting against His own Son.
And what will you do now?
I will preach the truth. Jesus is the Son of God!
Isn't that the man who came here to arrest the followers of Jesus?
It is! He was dragging Christians away in chains! Now he's preaching their message?
Listen to me! I once persecuted those who followed Jesus. I believed they were my enemies. But on that road, I discovered that I was the one who was blind long before I lost my sight.
And now?
Now I know the truth. Jesus Christ is the Son of God, and I will spend my life proclaiming His name!
Even after all the evil you've done?
If God can show mercy to a man like me, then no one is beyond the reach of His grace.
For the man who once hunted Christians had become a servant of the very Savior he tried to destroy.
